question: What is the main aim of Montreal Protocol?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Protection of the Ozone layer.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The protection of the Ozone layer** is the main aim of the **Montreal Protocol.**
 
• The **Montreal Protocol** is an international treaty that was adopted on **September 16, 1987.**
 
• It is aimed to regulate the **production and use of chemicals contributing to the depletion of the ozone layer of the Earth.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Initially, it was signed by** 46 countries** but now has nearly **200 signatories.**
